# PubNub Platform

> Global infrastructure for real-time, interactive applications, in production since 2012. You build the application; PubNub runs the infrastructure underneath it: pub/sub messaging, presence, data storage, serverless logic, and access control. Backed by a 99.999% uptime SLA, with unlimited subscribers per channel. Inside a region, PubNub adds under 0.5 ms of processing overhead (from ingestion until a message is ready for delivery, excluding network transit); end-to-end delivery latency, publisher to subscriber including network transit, averages about 58 ms.

Every plan, including the Free plan, can run production apps on Production keysets. Free covers up to 200 monthly active users or 1 million transactions a month, with no credit card.

Every page listed below is also available as Markdown at the URL shown (append `.md` to any pubnub.com page). This file is a curated selection. When it does not list the page you need, use the full index at [llms-full.txt](https://www.pubnub.com/llms-full.txt) (about 200 KB). Current SDK versions and install commands live in the [SDK index](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks.md); this file intentionally does not pin versions.

## Start here

- [Quickstart](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): Publish a message and receive it in the same program, in the language you choose
- [Set up your account](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/architecture/authentication/set-up-your-account.md): Create an account and get the publish and subscribe keys every SDK needs
- [Choose an SDK](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks.md): Every maintained SDK with its current version, platform, and install command
- [Core concepts](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/architecture/core-concepts.md): Channel, message, User ID, timetoken, token, and membership defined in one page
- [How PubNub works](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/architecture/how-pubnub-works.md): Routing, latency, per-channel message ordering, offline recovery, and fault tolerance
- [API limits](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/architecture/limits.md): Soft and hard limits per API and what happens when you exceed each one
- [Full index](https://www.pubnub.com/llms-full.txt): Every docs and site page with a one-line description (about 200 KB). Use it when this file does not list the page you need

## Pub/Sub

- [Pub/Sub overview](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/pub-sub/overview.md): The publish/subscribe model, message types, and what PubNub guarantees versus what your app owns
- [Channels and naming](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/pub-sub/subscribe/channels.md): Valid channel names, dot-delimited naming, and how naming affects wildcard subscribe and permissions
- [Send messages](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/pub-sub/publish/send-different-message-types.md): Publish messages and signals with custom message types and metadata
- [Publish semantics](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/pub-sub/publish/overview.md): Delivery semantics, message ordering, the publish timetoken, and messages versus signals
- [Receive messages](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/pub-sub/subscribe/receive-messages.md): Create a subscription and register handlers for messages, signals, and other events
- [Subscriptions](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/pub-sub/subscribe/subscriptions.md): Subscription and subscription set objects for channels and channel groups
- [Message actions](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/pub-sub/message-actions/overview.md): Attach reactions, receipts, and other metadata to a published message
- [Connection management](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/architecture/connection-management/overview.md): Connection recovery with reconnection policies and timetoken-based catch-up after a network interruption
- [Data transport](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/architecture/data-transport-and-delivery.md): How PubNub transports messages over HTTP, why it works through proxies and firewalls, and what it means for latency

## Presence

- [Presence overview](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/presence/overview.md): Channel occupancy, join and leave status, and online state per channel
- [Presence events](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/presence/presence-events.md): Join, leave, timeout, and state-change events, and interval mode on high-occupancy channels
- [Receive presence events](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/presence/receive-presence-events.md): Subscribe with presence enabled and handle each event type
- [Presence state](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/presence/set-and-get-presence-state.md): Set and get custom per-user state such as typing or location
- [Occupancy](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/presence/occupancy.md): Here Now occupancy queries, count-only mode, and occupancy tracking on large channels

## Data storage

- [Data storage overview](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/data-storage/overview.md): Message Persistence, DataSync, App Context, and Files compared, and how to choose
- [Message Persistence](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/data-storage/message-history/overview.md): Store message history by timetoken with configurable retention
- [Retrieve message history](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/data-storage/message-history/retrieve-message-history.md): Fetch stored messages from one or more channels
- [App Context](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/data-storage/metadata/overview.md): User, channel, and membership metadata
- [DataSync](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/data-storage/structured-data/overview.md): Structured application data with entities, relationships, classes, and change events
- [Files](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/data-storage/files/overview.md): Upload files and share them through channels

## Security

- [Security overview](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/security/overview.md): Access control, encryption, and compliance in one page
- [Access Manager](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/security/access-control/overview.md): Token-based permissions for channels, channel groups, and users
- [Manage permissions](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/security/access-control/manage-permissions.md): Grant, change, and revoke tokens from your server
- [Encryption](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/security/encryption/overview.md): TLS in transit and 256-bit AES-CBC through the CryptoModule for message and file content
- [Security best practices](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/design-patterns/security.md): Token-issuing flows, secret-key rotation, and when to add end-to-end encryption

## SDKs

- [JavaScript](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/javascript.md): Browsers, Node.js, React. `npm install pubnub`
- [Python](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/python.md): `pip install pubnub`
- [Python asyncio](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/asyncio.md): Same package as Python, asyncio API
- [Java](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/java.md): Android and JVM. Gradle or Maven
- [Kotlin](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/kotlin.md): Android and JVM. Gradle or Maven
- [Swift](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/swift.md): iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS. Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods
- [Objective-C](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/objective-c.md): iOS and macOS. CocoaPods
- [C#](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/c-sharp.md): .NET. `dotnet add package PubNub`
- [Go](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/go.md): Go server applications. The module path includes the major version, so copy the `go get` command from this page
- [PHP](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/php.md): `composer require pubnub/pubnub`
- [Ruby](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/ruby.md): `gem install pubnub`
- [Rust](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/rust.md): `cargo add pubnub`
- [Dart](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/dart.md): Flutter and standalone Dart. `dart pub add pubnub`
- [Unity](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/unity.md): Unity Editor. Unity Package Manager
- [Unreal Engine](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/unreal.md): Unreal Editor plugin
- [C](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/c.md): Linux, macOS, Windows, FreeRTOS, ESP-IDF. Use for new embedded projects
- [C-Core (legacy)](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/c-core.md): Legacy embedded library. POSIX, Windows, FreeRTOS, and Mbed variants are listed in the SDK index

## HTTP APIs

- [REST API](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks/rest-api/introduction.md): Call any PubNub feature over HTTP without an SDK. Links to every endpoint
- [Admin API](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/admin-api.md): Create and configure apps and keysets from code or CI/CD
- [Admin API versions](https://admin-api.pubnub.com/v2/versions): JSON list of versions. Take the `version` of the entry with `isLatest: true` and fetch the OpenAPI 3.1 spec from `https://admin-api.pubnub.com/v2/openapi.json?version={version}`

## Functions and integrations

- [Functions](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/message-processing/serverless/overview.md): Serverless JavaScript that runs on message events, trigger types, and limits
- [Function types](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/serverless-sdk/function-types.md): Execution semantics of every trigger type
- [Functions modules](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/serverless-sdk/modules-and-libraries/overview.md): Built-in modules available through require()
- [Events & Actions](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/integrations/event-forwarding/overview.md): Forward PubNub events to webhooks, AWS, Kafka, and other targets
- [Mobile push notifications](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/integrations/mobile-push-notifications/overview.md): Send push through APNs and FCM from channels
- [Kafka](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/integrations/kafka-overview.md): Move data between Kafka topics and PubNub channels in either direction
- [Moderation](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/message-processing/moderation/overview.md): Channel Monitor for manual review and Auto Moderation before publish

## Analytics

- [Illuminate](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/analytics/decisions/overview.md): Custom real-time metrics and automated decisions
- [Insights](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/analytics/usage-dashboards/overview.md): Usage and behavior dashboards
- [Operational dashboards](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/analytics/operational-dashboards.md): Admin Portal operational metrics and raw metrics export

## AI development

- [Set up the MCP server](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/ai-development/set-up-mcp-server.md): Connect a coding tool to the hosted server with OAuth or to a local server with an API key
- [MCP tools](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/ai-development/available-mcp-tools.md): Every tool, resource, and prompt the MCP server exposes
- [Prompt templates](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/ai-development/prompt-templates.md): Ready-made prompts for common PubNub tasks

## Troubleshooting and design

- [Error codes](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/design-patterns/error-codes.md): HTTP status codes, what each means, and SDK status categories

- [Stop receiving messages](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/pub-sub/subscribe/stop-receiving-messages.md): How to unsubscribe a subscription or subscription set, stop every subscription a client holds with unsubscribeAll, remove an event listener independently of unsubscribing, and read the status event that confirms a deliberate stop.

## The PubNub platform, detailed.

Explore the PubNub platform, starting with Programmable Pub/Sub. From there, investigate all of the PubNub platform features to build your real-time application.

### Developer Tools+

The developer-experience surface: what you run on your machine, and what your coding agent runs for you. The docs call that second half AI development, and give it a top-level area.

What you can ship with it

A working real-time feature scaffolded by your coding agent in an afternoon.

Features include:

50+ SDKs

Idiomatic clients for web, mobile, server, and embedded

APIs

Plain REST when you’d rather not take an SDK

MCP server

Claude and Cursor can scaffold PubNub features for you

PubNub Skills

Task recipes your coding agent follows correctly

llms.txt

The documentation set in one file a model can read

Prompt templates

Starting points for what agents actually get asked

Without it you build

Client libraries for every platform your app ships on

[Read the docs](https://www.pubnub.com/docs/sdks)

### Programmable Pub/Sub+

The heart of PubNub’s technology — sending and receiving messages between humans, devices, and AIs. Low-latency publish/subscribe you can program: clients publish to named channels, and subscribe to the channels they care about.

What you can ship with it

Typing indicators, read receipts, and reactions in a chat app.

Features include:

Channels

A route clients join — named on the fly, never provisioned

Subscriptions

One connection, many channels, one set of listeners

Message Actions

Reactions, receipts, and edits on a sent message

Signals

Cheap high-frequency updates like typing indicators

Message types

Categorize the traffic that shares a channel

Channel Groups

Subscribe to thousands of channels in one call

Without it you build

Ordered delivery, catch-up after reconnect, and fan-out at scale

```
pubnub.publish({ channel: "scores", message: score })
```
